integrity: Proof uses exact integer finite certificates and an analytic witness. No independent scientific audit or external certification has been carried out.
scientific_limitations: Finite lower-bound enumeration covers tree orders two through seven only.
The outbreak model is independent-edge Reed–Frost transmission with one uniformly chosen surviving seed and one perfect pre-vaccination.
Continuous-time infection/recovery, non-tree networks, heterogeneous contacts, and multiple doses are not covered.
Bibliographic originality has residual risk, especially pre-existing heuristics and unpublished small-network enumerations.
title: Eight vertices are sharp for a transmissibility-dependent vaccination target on trees
